collocations: mean to do something 打算做某事
mean to have him 打算嫁给他（本文用法）
mean somebody to do something 打算让某人做某事
mean to succeed 决心成功
compare: mean to do = intend to do：说话人有意去做。I mean to have him. = I intend to marry him.
mean doing = involve or result in：说的是后果，不是意图。Taking the job means moving away. = 接受这份工作意味着搬走。
mean something to somebody = be important to them：Your friendship means a lot to me. = 你的友谊对我很重要。
71.usage: 表达“打算做”用 mean + to-infinitive；表达“意味着做”用 mean + -ing。本文 I mean to have him 中的 have 指“嫁给／得到这个人”，结合人物对话理解，不宜按普通的“拥有物品”翻译。
